name: referral-readiness
title: Referral Readiness
summary: Compare required documents against what exists for one hospital, plan and visit type, report the missing kinds, and re-check only what changed.
when_to_use: The workflow is in READINESS_CHECK after a hospital and doctor have been chosen
A hospital, plan or visit type changed mid-workflow and the previous readiness result is invalidated
A new document arrived and only the checks it could affect should be re-run
A booking attempt is about to run and the package must be certified complete for that facility

inputs.name: requirement
inputs.description: Published requirements for a hospital, narrowed by plan and keyed by visit_type; carries max_document_age_days and requires_prior_auth_reference.

inputs.name: documents
inputs.description: Each document with its kind, extracted fields and unreadable_fields.

inputs.name: hospital_id
inputs.description: One of the three keys that select the requirement set.

inputs.name: plan_id
inputs.description: Narrows the requirement set when the hospital publishes plan-specific rules.

inputs.name: visit_type
inputs.description: first_visit or return_visit; requirements differ and are not interchangeable.

inputs.name: prior_readiness
inputs.description: An earlier result, present on the re-check path so unaffected checks can be carried forward.

outputs.name: readiness
outputs.description: checks, satisfied, missing_kinds, can_proceed and evidence_ids, checked_at.

outputs.name: checks
outputs.description: One per required kind, each satisfied, missing, expired, unreadable or not_required, with its own run_id.

outputs.name: decision
outputs.description: Reason code is ok, document_missing, document_unreadable, stale_evidence or conflicting_evidence.

references.purpose: Requirement condition to DocumentCheck status and reason code, including the age-limit and prior-auth cases.
